game_name: Initial D Arcade Stage Ver. 3 Cycraft Edition (Export, Rev A) (GDS-0039A)
general_issues: Select inidv3ca.zip or the merged parent archive inidv3cy.zip. Select the exact set in Game Revision; merged archives must contain that revision. Keep naomi2.zip beside the ROM ZIP. Required CHD: gds-0039a.chd, initiald3_smcp_v1.66.chd. Select CHD Root below the ROM ZIP; disks may be in the set/parent subfolder or directly in that folder.
